economic_mechanism: US headline inflation acceleration may shift energy producer margins relative to industrial users, but macro information may already be priced. Cross-source interaction with independently observed sector price strength may be redundant or detrimental.

market.limitation: Adj close restated for dividends; no actual fill quotes

inflation.limitation: Current-vintage CPI, not archived vintage; two-month signal lag below

cashflow: USD 1 initially, no deposits/withdrawals. Unlevered 60% SPY core and 40% sector sleeve (XLE or XLI). USD US-CPI real wealth before taxes/FX.

signals.CPI: For entry month t, use month t-2 CPI YoY rate CPI[t-2]/CPI[t-14]-1; compare same rate for month t-5 CPI[t-5]/CPI[t-17]-1. Accelerating if difference>0. No current or prior-month CPI leakage.
signals.relative_sector: At last completed trading close of month t-1 compute 6-calendar-month adjusted-price return of XLE and XLI, using closest trading close on/before that 6-month cutoff. XLE_6m>XLI_6m indicates relative energy strength.
signals.combined: 60% SPY + 40% XLE only if CPI accelerating AND XLE relative 6-month strength positive; otherwise 60% SPY + 40% XLI.
signals.macro_only: 60% SPY+40% XLE if CPI accelerating, else 40% XLI
signals.price_only: 60% SPY+40% XLE if XLE 6m return > XLI 6m return, else 40% XLI

execution: First ETF trading session CLOSE of t to first ETF trading session CLOSE t+1. Signal from previous EOM and lagged CPI; target weights rebalanced monthly from drifted weights; no intramonth trades. Adjusted closes proxy total returns; no tax or FX, 10 bps per USD notional bought/sold, once per trade.
metrics: nominal and US-CPI deflated terminal wealth
combined minus mixed, macro_only and price_only terminal wealth
counterexample: Energy has different beta and commodity convexity; CPI is generally expected and cannot capture surprises. Static XLE or XLI may outperform adaptive, and cost/overfitting reduce the edge. Any success is exploratory contaminated given 2026 model knowledge.
rules: Exactly 6 predeclared arms. No parameter searches, no post hoc threshold shifts, no winner selection as scientific validation, no real orders; count this as second historical trial in research burst.
stop: Compute one fixed economic test with accuracy checks. PARK/NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED if combined not better than static mixed and both ablations; record result honestly.
